name: stage2_new_station
registered: 2026-09-26 (before any stage-2 model was trained or evaluated)

folds.rule: held-out stations are removed from ALL years (fit, early stopping, normalization statistics, EMOS fitting); only their 2016 records are scored

methods.emos_gl: global EMOS, min-CRPS, fit on training stations 2007-2014
methods.emos_bst_gl: global boosted EMOS (Gaussian, log-link scale, ML, component-wise boosting on all 38 predictors, step 0.05, max 1000 iterations, AIC stopping), fit on training stations 2007-2014
methods.nn_unk: NN-aux-emb; unseen stations use reserved UNK embedding trained with 5% station dropout
methods.nn_knn: same trained networks as nn_unk; unseen-station embedding = inverse-distance-weighted mean of the k=5 nearest training stations' embeddings, distance sqrt(d_km^2 + (0.1 km/m * d_alt_m)^2)
methods.nn_noemb: no embedding; station attributes are inputs
methods.nn_attr: embedding = MLP(station attributes) -> 2-d, trained jointly, used for all stations
methods.nn_hybrid: PROPOSED. embedding = MLP(attributes) + free per-station offset delta_s; delta_s zeroed with probability 0.5 per sample during training; unseen stations use delta = 0
methods.nn_hybrid_res: EXPLORATORY secondary: nn_hybrid + residual mean (mu = ens_mean + f) + constrained spread sigma = sqrt(softplus(c)^2 + softplus(d)^2 s^2)
methods.nn_hybrid_knn: EXPLORATORY secondary: nn_hybrid with delta for unseen stations = kNN-IDW mean of training deltas (same k, distance as nn_knn)

nn_hyperparameters.refit: none (model at best 2015 epoch is used)

reference_seen_stations.emos_loc_bst: per-station boosted EMOS fit on 2007-2015 excluding station-specific features, AIC stopping, tested on 2016 of all seen stations (stage-1 setting; compare with paper 0.80)

metrics.primary: mean Gaussian CRPS over all 2016 records of held-out stations, pooled over the 7 folds (each station held out exactly once)
secondary: PIT histogram (10 bins) and reliability index
metrics.reporting: per method: (a) CRPS of the 10-seed ensemble (mean of mu and sigma over seeds) [primary], (b) mean +- sd over seeds of single-seed CRPS; per-fold CRPS; CRPS vs distance to nearest training station

significance.test: Diebold-Mariano on the 366 daily-mean CRPS differences (Newey-West lag 5), two-sided, seed-ensemble forecasts
significance.bootstrap: moving-block bootstrap, block 7 days, 10000 reps, 95% CI of mean difference
significance.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.05 across the 6 primary comparisons
significance.station_level: station-wise DM (lag 1) + BH q=0.05, fraction of held-out stations significantly better/worse
significance.secondary_comparisons: all other pairs reported without claims

decision_rules: The proposed method is claimed better than a competitor only if the BH-adjusted DM test is significant AND the bootstrap CI excludes 0 AND the sign agrees in the spatial-fold check.
No hyperparameter or variant is selected using 2016 data. nn_hybrid_res and nn_hybrid_knn remain exploratory regardless of their results.
